name: Phosphor Slipstream
description: The strip leg of the official Phosphor set. While the strip scrolls it slips into its stream form: the content separates into luminous horizontal streams that lag and bow behind the motion on their own clocks, energized between glowing seams that carry the brand gradient, with ember sparks shed in the wake. As the strip settles the streams reunite and the settled image carries no residue.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Streams
parameters.description: How many streams the strip separates into.

parameters.name: Separation
parameters.description: How far the streams desynchronize and pinch apart at a given scroll speed.

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: How brightly the streams energize and the gradient seams glow.

parameters.name: Embers
parameters.description: How many ember sparks drift in the wake.
